page.content:
Psychohistorian who founds the Foundations.

How Hari Seldon connects

  • Faction: First Foundation — Seldon founds the First Foundation on Terminus.
  • Concept: Psychohistory — Seldon develops psychohistory as a predictive science.
  • Work: Foundation (book) — The first book opens with Hari Seldon and the trial.
  • Faction: Second Foundation — Seldon also plants the hidden Second Foundation.
  • Concept: Seldon Plan — Seldon designs the Plan that the Foundations serve.
  • Location: Time Vault — Seldon appears in the Vault at each predicted crisis.
  • Location: Trantor — Seldon's trial and court years happen on Trantor.

What is Hari Seldon?

Hari Seldon is the Trantor mathematician who proves Empire will fall, stands trial, and plants two Foundations — one visible on Terminus, one hidden.

Key threads lead to First Foundation, Psychohistory, Foundation (book), Second Foundation, Seldon Plan and Time Vault.
